note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Lakewood-Laona District) in tall pines along the North Branch of the Oconto River at Bagley Rapids; about a third of the sites sit near the river and some look at the rapids through the trees. Trout fishing; spring whitewater paddling. ATVs and UTVs are barred in the campground. --Claude
